text:
marta: Quick sync - planning to lift a regional pin for runtime-2.16 in ap-southeast tonight during the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. This is a staged unpin with an extra SDK-binding check for customers using SDK v3.x with the new connection pool.

jordan: Can we list explicit bindings that previously caused failures? I remember a few customers had issues when SDK reused KV cache handles across requests.

marta: Right - previous failures were: 1) gptx-stream when using longseq+kv-shard; 2) model llama2q with legacy tokenizers in SDK v2.9. We're not touching those in this rollout but we will validate SDK v3.x binding behavior.

deploybot: [deploybot] Proposed pinlist patch (preview): ```diff
--- pinlist/runtime.yaml (v2.15)
+++ pinlist/runtime.yaml (v2.16)
@@
-  - model: gptx-stream
-    reason: sticky-kv-shard-longseq
+  # gptx-stream still pinned in ap-southeast for dedicated users
+  - model: llama2q-legacy
+    reason: reserved-for-compat-testing
```

ops-lead: Rollback criteria proposal: any canary region p95 latency >20% vs baseline for 5m OR sustained 502/5xx >1.5% for 10m. Also fail fast on memory OOM alerts from runtime pods.

qa-bot: I'll run the binding smoke harness at 01:00 UTC against a canary fleet (tokenization, connection reuse, multi-tenant isolation). Output will attach a short CSV of traces.

marta: Canary plan: start at 1% traffic for 20m, run binding harness, if green increase to 3% for 40m with eval prompts for generation + embeddings. If still stable, 10% for 30m then full regional lift.

jordan: For Dedicated customers in ap-southeast, we should keep a safelist. Suggest we keep "llama2q-legacy" and "gptx-stream" pinned until we validate customer-specific patches. Can we do a per-customer opt-in to unpin?

deploybot: [deploybot] staging action queued. To approve: react with :white_check_mark:. To request hold: react with :warning:. Deploy will start at 02:00 UTC if >=2 approvals.

sre-oncall: I'll watch autoscaler churn and per-pod OOM rates. Adding dashboard panels for connection-pool-saturation and kvcache-hitrate. If autoscaler bounces >3 times in 15m, we'll abort.

kai: One more check: SDK v3.6 introduced a non-blocking shutdown for pool sockets. We need to verify no fd leaks under high QPS. I'll run a 15-minute load soak at 500 req/s in staging at 01:30 UTC.

marta: Rollback runbook quick commands if needed:
```bash
# abort rollout
deploybot hold --region ap-southeast --reason "safelist hold" 
# full rollback to pinned runtime
deploybot rollback --region ap-southeast --runtime 2.15 --reason "post-unpin regression"
# reapply model pin
deploybot pin add --region ap-southeast --model gptx-stream --note "re-pin on regression"
```

jordan: Also please paste the release-note blurb we send to customer success for Dedicated accounts, we should include opt-in steps and how to request re-pin.

marta: Draft for CS: "We will be lifting a regional runtime pin for ap-southeast (runtime-2.16). Dedicated customers currently pinned on gptx-stream or llama2q-legacy will remain on their pinned versions. If you would like to opt into the new runtime for testing, please open an internal ticket referencing the rollout ID. We will monitor telemetry closely and can re-pin within 15 minutes if regressions are detected."

qa-bot: Smoke harness results: tokenization OK, no fd leaks observed in 15m soak, kvcache hit-rate steady. Attaching summarized results here.

ops-lead: Approving. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: Approving after dashboards added. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: [deploybot] change scheduled for 02:00 UTC. Will post status updates to this thread once canary starts and when ramp phases occur.

marta: Thanks team. If anyone sees an unexpected spike or customer escalation, call it out here immediately and tag @sre-oncall + @ops-lead. We plan a 3-hour monitoring window post-lift.
